label: Films, decoded on the wall
description: Films from the media directory at the wall's own resolution, compressed on the way and decoded by the Pi itself; a layout of several walls, one film across them all, is started from the command line

film.label: Film
film.description: One film, over and over; all plays them in turn

fit.label: Fit
fit.description: Cover the walls, cropping the film to their shape; letterbox it whole in black; or letterbox it against the top, all the black below

audio.label: Sound here
audio.description: Play the film's sound on the machine the sender runs on, on the walls' clock
